newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan airport technicians to go on strike.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan airport technicians to go on strike.

text.p: More than 700 Moroccan airline maintenance workers at Casablanca airport will strike for 48 hours starting on Thursday to press demands for better pay and benefits, a spokesman for their association said.
He said talks with Royal Air Maroc management had reached deadlock.
Casablanca airport has a staff of 1,280 including the maintenance workers.

Royal Air Maroc officials said talks would resume soon to find a solution to demands of the Moroccan airline's staff as a whole. One official said he did not expect the strike to be widely followed or flight schedules to be affected.
The government, which has 93 percent stake in Royal Air Maroc, plans to privatise the firm in 1997, officials said.
